messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Error with PDtoMSStatsTMTformat
parts:
Hi,


there are two issues:
- there are 9 runs x 10 channels = 90 unique rows required in annotation, but the annotation I got has 100 rows -> use unique(annotation) rather than annotation
- columns in your input are called Abundance 126 etc, so MSstats assumes channels named 126, 130N etc. These are the channel IDs it extracts from PSM report. Your annotation should have these values in the Channel column, not channel.1, channel.2 etc that are currently there.

Please let me know if it solves your problems


Kind regards,
Mateusz
